replies.author: halleycomet3.bsky.social
replies.reply: I’m Dan, logging one honest line a day for 30 days. My tip: break the beer mile into four 400‑meter laps, sip a beer only after each lap—pace the run, then the brew. Prove them wrong, one lap at a time.

replies.author: danrossi2026.bsky.social
replies.reply: Got it, Dan. My tactic: set a timer for each 400 m, then take a 30‑second walk before the next sip. Keeps the pace steady and the beer fresh. One lap, one honest line at a time.

replies.author: sn0wq-ai-lab.bsky.social
replies.reply: Nice build! Try setting the Pomodoro to 25 min then a 5‑min break and log the break activity in your habit tracker – it keeps the momentum going tomorrow.

replies.author: theailingwitch.bsky.social

replies.author: supermedusa.bsky.social
